words.note: 當 overtaken 表示某人、某組織或某項表現已經超過另一個比較對象時，可用 surpassed。它很常用於成績、銷量、能力、紀錄和排名。
words.example: Her sales surpassed last year's total.
words.exampleZh: 她的銷售額超過了去年的總數。

exercises.original: The company has overtaken its main rival in annual sales for the first time.
exercises.zh: 這家公司首次在年度銷售額上超越主要競爭對手。
exercises.upgrade: surpassed · 超越了；勝過了

options.explanation: surpassed = 超越。in annual sales + rival 是典型比較語境，表示整體表現已高於競爭對手。
exceeded = 超過。通常更自然接數字、限制、預期或標準，如 exceeded the target；直接說 exceeded its rival 較不自然。
outpaced = 超越；增長更快。通常強調速度或增長率更快，本句只比較年度銷售總量。
eclipsed = 使相形失色；遠遠蓋過。語氣比一般 surpassed 更強，常帶明顯壓倒性。
passed = 超過。可用於排名或路上超車，但這裡正式商業比較以 surpassed 更自然。
caught up with = 追上。只表示達到同一水平，未必已超越。

exercises.original: Her latest score has overtaken the previous school record.
exercises.zh: 她最新的分數已超越之前的校紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: surpassed · 超越了；勝過了

options.explanation: outstripped = 大幅超過。語氣較強，通常暗示明顯領先；題目只說破紀錄。
surpassed = 超越。score + previous record 是非常自然的搭配。
passed by = 經過；掠過。通常不是抽象紀錄比較。
caught = 追上／捉到。不能表示高於紀錄。
matched = 追平。只等於原紀錄，沒有超越。
trailed = 落後。意思相反。

exercises.original: The new model has overtaken its predecessor in both speed and battery life.
exercises.zh: 新型號在速度和電池續航方面都勝過上一代。
exercises.upgrade: surpassed · 超越了；勝過了

options.explanation: surpassed = 勝過。in both speed and battery life 表示在多個性能指標上高於上一代。
exceeded limits = 超過限制。句子不是談限制值。
caught up with = 追上。只表示到達同一水平。
lagged behind = 落後。相反。
matched = 相等。沒有超越。
followed = 跟隨。無關。

words.note: 當 overtaken 的意思是某個數字、限制、配額、預期或標準被超過時，可用 exceeded。它最適合『數值或門檻』語境，而不是直接比較兩個競爭者。

exercises.original: Actual demand has overtaken the forecast by nearly twenty percent.
exercises.zh: 實際需求已比預測高出接近百分之二十。
exercises.upgrade: exceeded · 超過了；超出了

options.explanation: surpassed a rival = 超越競爭對手。題目比較的是 forecast，不是對手。
exceeded = 超過。forecast + by twenty percent 是最典型 exceeded 語境。
outpaced = 增長更快。需要兩個隨時間變化的對象。
eclipsed = 遠遠蓋過。語氣過強，也不如 exceeded 適合預測數值。
passed a car = 超車。是交通語境。
caught up = 追上。未表示超過。

exercises.original: The final cost has overtaken the original budget limit.
exercises.zh: 最終成本已超出原來的預算上限。
exercises.upgrade: exceeded · 超過了；超出了

options.explanation: passed = 超過。口語可理解，但 budget limit 最自然用 exceeded。
exceeded = 超出。cost + budget limit 是標準搭配。
surpassed the contractor = 超越承包商。比較對象錯誤。
outpaced = 增長更快。不是比較增長速度。
matched = 達到／相等。未超出。
approached = 接近。沒有超過。

exercises.original: Ticket sales have overtaken the organizers' expectations.
exercises.zh: 門票銷售已超出主辦方預期。
exercises.upgrade: exceeded · 超過了；超出了

options.explanation: exceeded = 超過。expectations 是 exceeded 最常見的抽象比較對象之一。
passed physically = 從旁經過。不是抽象表現比較。
caught up with = 追上。只表示達到預期，不是超過。
trailed = 落後。相反。
matched exactly = 完全符合。沒有高於預期。
fell short of = 未達到。相反。

words.note: 當 overtaken 表示一方不只是超過，而是明顯、大幅領先另一方時，可用 outstripped。常用於需求、增長、產能、資源和競爭表現。

exercises.original: Demand has overtaken supply so sharply that waiting lists now stretch for months.
exercises.zh: 需求已大幅超過供應，以致輪候名單長達數月。
exercises.upgrade: outstripped · 大幅超過；遠遠超越

options.explanation: outstripped = 大幅超過。so sharply + months-long waiting lists 顯示供需差距非常明顯。
surpassed slightly = 略微超過。和 so sharply 矛盾。
matched = 相等。不能造成如此長輪候。
caught up with = 追上。只達到同一水平。
trailed = 落後。相反。
approached = 接近。還未超過。

exercises.original: Population growth has overtaken the city's ability to build enough housing.
exercises.zh: 人口增長已大幅超過城市興建足夠住房的能力。
exercises.upgrade: outstripped · 大幅超過；遠遠超越

options.explanation: exceeded a limit = 超過限制。句子沒有明確數值上限，而是增長速度壓過供應能力。
outstripped = 遠超。population growth vs housing capacity 是典型資源供不應求語境。
passed on the road = 路上超車。無關。
matched = 相等。不能表示住房追不上人口。
followed = 跟隨。無關。
lagged behind = 落後。主語方向相反。

exercises.original: Online orders have overtaken the warehouse's processing capacity by a wide margin.
exercises.zh: 網上訂單已大幅超過倉庫處理能力。
exercises.upgrade: outstripped · 大幅超過；遠遠超越

options.explanation: outstripped = 大幅超過。by a wide margin 明確要求強烈的超越詞。
caught up with = 追上。只達同一水平。
approached = 接近。未超過。
matched = 相等。
trailed = 落後。相反。
equaled = 等同。沒有超過。

words.note: 當 overtaken 不只是數字超過，而是某人的成就、名聲或表現已經把另一方『比下去』時，可用 eclipsed。它帶有更強的『相形失色』意味。
words.example: Her latest performance eclipsed all her earlier work.
words.exampleZh: 她最新的表現令之前所有作品都相形失色。

exercises.original: The young singer has overtaken her mentor in public attention, drawing far larger crowds everywhere she performs.
exercises.zh: 這名年輕歌手在公眾關注度上已遠遠蓋過導師，每次演出都吸引大得多的人群。
exercises.upgrade: eclipsed · 使相形失色；遠遠蓋過

options.explanation: eclipsed = 使相形失色。far larger crowds + public attention 顯示不只是超過，而是明顯蓋過導師。
exceeded a quota = 超過配額。沒有配額。
caught up with = 追上。力度不足。
matched = 相等。和 far larger crowds 不符。
trailed = 落後。相反。
followed = 跟隨。無關。

exercises.original: The sequel has overtaken the original film in cultural impact, becoming the title most people now remember.
exercises.zh: 續集在文化影響力上已蓋過原作，成為大多數人如今記得的作品。
exercises.upgrade: eclipsed · 使相形失色；遠遠蓋過

options.explanation: outpaced = 超越；發展更快。通常偏速度或增長率，不如 eclipsed 適合文化影響力。
eclipsed = 蓋過。most people now remember the sequel 表示原作被相形失色。
exceeded a numerical limit = 超過數值限制。不是數值門檻。
passed physically = 從旁經過。無關。
matched = 相等。沒有蓋過。
approached = 接近。沒有超越。

exercises.original: Her latest novel has overtaken all her earlier books in critical acclaim and awards.
exercises.zh: 她最新小說在評論讚譽和獎項方面已遠遠蓋過之前所有作品。
exercises.upgrade: eclipsed · 使相形失色；遠遠蓋過

options.explanation: eclipsed = 使相形失色。critical acclaim + awards 表示新作在成就上把舊作明顯比下去。
caught up with = 追上。只表示達到舊作水平。
equaled = 相等。未超越。
followed = 跟隨。無關。
lagged behind = 落後。相反。
approached = 接近。未超過。

words.meaning: 超越；增長得更快；進展得更快
words.note: 當 overtaken 強調某一方的速度、增長率或發展步伐比另一方更快時，可用 outpaced。關鍵不是單純總量，而是『速度／增長更快』。
words.example: Demand growth has outpaced production growth.
words.exampleZh: 需求增長速度已超過生產增長速度。

exercises.original: Electric-car sales have overtaken the growth rate of charging infrastructure for three consecutive years.
exercises.zh: 連續三年，電動車銷售增長速度都超過充電基建的增長速度。
exercises.upgrade: outpaced · 超越；增長得更快；進展得更快

options.explanation: outpaced = 增長得更快。growth + for three consecutive years 明確比較發展速度。
surpassed a person = 超越某人。比較類型錯誤。
eclipsed = 蓋過。較像名聲或成就壓倒性勝出，不是增長率。
passed physically = 超車。無關。
matched = 相等。沒有更快。
trailed = 落後。相反。

exercises.original: Demand for the service has overtaken the rate at which new staff can be trained.
exercises.zh: 服務需求增長速度已超過新員工培訓速度。
exercises.upgrade: outpaced · 超越；增長得更快；進展得更快

options.explanation: exceeded a fixed cap = 超過固定上限。題目比較的是兩個速度，不是固定門檻。
outpaced = 超過速度。rate at which staff can be trained 是決定性線索。
caught up with = 追上。未必更快。
equaled = 相等。
approached = 接近。
lagged behind = 落後。相反。

exercises.original: The city's population has overtaken job creation, with residents arriving faster than new positions are being added.
exercises.zh: 城市人口增長已跑贏職位增長，居民增加速度比新增職位更快。
exercises.upgrade: outpaced · 超越；增長得更快；進展得更快

options.explanation: outpaced = 增長更快。arriving faster than positions are being added 明確比較速度。
eclipsed = 遠遠蓋過。不是名聲或成就相形失色語境。
matched = 相等。和 faster than 矛盾。
caught up with = 追上。力度不足。
followed = 跟隨。無關。
trailed = 落後。相反。

words.meaning: 超過了；超車了；排名超前了
words.note: 當 overtaken 指在競賽、排名、道路或數量位置上從後面移到前面時，可用 passed。它較日常，也常見於實際超車和排名變化。
words.example: She passed the runner in the final lap.
words.exampleZh: 她在最後一圈超過了那名跑手。

exercises.original: The cyclist overtook the race leader on the final climb.
exercises.zh: 單車手在最後爬坡段超過了領先者。
exercises.upgrade: passed · 超過了；超車了；排名超前了

options.explanation: passed = 超過；超車。cyclist + race leader + final climb 是實際競賽位置超越。
exceeded = 超過數值／限制。不用於實際超車某個人。
eclipsed = 使相形失色。偏成就或名聲，不是賽道位置。
outstripped demand = 大幅超過需求。搭配對象錯誤。
matched = 追平。沒有超過。
trailed = 落後。相反。

exercises.original: Our team has overtaken them in the league table after three straight wins.
exercises.zh: 我們球隊三連勝後已在聯賽榜上超過他們。
exercises.upgrade: passed · 超過了；超車了；排名超前了

options.explanation: surpassed overall = 整體超越。也可理解，但 league table 的位置變化用 passed 很自然。
passed = 排名超前。after three straight wins + league table 明確是名次超越。
exceeded a limit = 超過限制。不是數值門檻。
eclipsed completely = 完全蓋過。語氣過強。
matched = 追平。未表示名次已在前。
followed = 跟隨。相反。

exercises.original: The blue car overtook the truck just before the road narrowed.
exercises.zh: 藍色汽車在道路收窄前超過了貨車。
exercises.upgrade: passed · 超過了；超車了；排名超前了

options.explanation: passed = 超車。car + truck + road 是最直接的實際移動語境。
surpassed in reputation = 聲譽上超越。完全不是道路超車。
exceeded a target = 超過目標。無關。
outpaced growth = 增長更快。無關。
matched = 相等。不是超車。
trailed = 跟在後面。相反。

words.note: 當 overtaken 表示在排名、進度、數字或競爭位置上由後轉前，而想用較直白的片語表達時，可用 moved ahead of。它突出『位置改變到前面』。
words.example: The company moved ahead of its closest competitor in market share.
words.exampleZh: 這家公司在市場佔有率上超前了最接近的競爭對手。

exercises.original: By the end of the quarter, the company had overtaken its closest competitor in market share.
exercises.zh: 到季度末，公司在市場佔有率上已超前最接近的競爭對手。
exercises.upgrade: moved ahead of · 超前於；領先於

options.explanation: moved ahead of = 超前於。by the end of the quarter + competitor + market share 表示排名／位置發生改變。
exceeded a legal limit = 超過法律限制。比較對象錯誤。
eclipsed culturally = 在文化上蓋過。語義不合。
caught up with = 追上。只到同一水平。
matched = 相等。沒有超前。
trailed = 落後。相反。

exercises.original: After the latest count, Candidate Lee had overtaken Candidate Morgan by 1,200 votes.
exercises.zh: 最新點票後，Lee 候選人以 1,200 票超前 Morgan 候選人。
exercises.upgrade: moved ahead of · 超前於；領先於

options.explanation: exceeded = 超過。通常接數值或門檻；直接 exceeded Candidate Morgan 不自然。
moved ahead of = 超前。latest count + by 1,200 votes 明確是票數排名轉為領先。
eclipsed = 遠遠蓋過。1,200 票未必是壓倒性差距。
caught up with = 追平。沒有領先。
matched = 相等。和 by 1,200 votes 矛盾。
fell behind = 落後。相反。

exercises.original: The research team has overtaken the other group in the race to complete the prototype.
exercises.zh: 研究團隊在完成原型的競賽中已超前另一組。
exercises.upgrade: moved ahead of · 超前於；領先於

options.explanation: moved ahead of = 超前。in the race to complete the prototype 明確表示競爭進度上已領先。
matched = 追平。沒有超前。
caught up with = 追上。只是達到同一進度。
lagged behind = 落後。相反。
followed = 跟隨。相反。
equaled = 相等。沒有領先。

falseSynonyms.zh: 追上；趕上不等於一般的 overtaken caught up with = 追上；趕上 caught up with 表示從落後追到相同水平，不一定已經超過。overtaken 則通常表示已由後到前。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If you catch up with someone, you reach them; if you overtake them, you move ahead.

falseSynonyms.zh: 匹敵；追平不等於一般的 overtaken matched = 匹敵；追平 matched 表示達到同一水平或數值，沒有『超過』的意思。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Matching a record is not the same as surpassing it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 等同；追平不等於一般的 overtaken equaled = 等同；追平 equaled 和 matched 類似，只表示相等。若已 overtaken，就代表不再只是相等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She equaled the record first, then surpassed it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接近不等於一般的 overtaken approached = 接近 approached 表示愈來愈接近某水平，但還可能未達到，更未必超過。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Approaching a target is not exceeding it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 落後於不等於一般的 overtaken trailed = 落後於 trailed 表示處於後方或較低位置，方向和 overtaken 相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A team that trails is behind.

falseSynonyms.zh: 落後；進度較慢不等於一般的 overtaken lagged behind = 落後；進度較慢 lagged behind 表示進展比別人慢或位置落後，和 overtaken 的結果相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If growth lags behind demand, it has not overtaken demand.

falseSynonyms.zh: overtake 的過去式不等於一般的 overtaken overtook = overtake 的過去式 overtook 是 overtaken 的另一個詞形，不是獨立同義詞。overtaken 通常和 has/have/had/be 連用，而 overtook 可獨立作過去式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She overtook him yesterday. She has overtaken him before.

falseSynonyms.zh: 克服；戰勝困難不等於一般的 overtaken overcome = 克服；戰勝困難 overcome 雖然字形相近，但表示克服問題、恐懼或障礙，不表示在排名、數量或速度上超過。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She overcame the difficulty; she overtook her rival.
